conclusions.text: The four retained comparison rows support only GSHHG-relative mapped-land support and one compatible 2018 USA ADM2 Counties target each.

The existing Alaska 11 rule uses a matching source profile and predicates but its exact approved roster excludes these four; a bounded extension awaits independent review. Current physical land/water, observation date/accuracy, cause and repair authority remain unresolved.
